rounds.title: Slider baseline
rounds.note: The SDK slider (et-slider) and range slider (et-range-slider), first drawing, drawn by slider() from @ethlete/components/design/slider with the real markup and CSS: et-label with the required marker, the interaction box with rail, fill, ticks with and without labels, one or two thumbs with the value bubble an etSliderThumbLabel template renders, et-form-support with hint and error; the brand theme, danger as the error theme. Hover, focus-visible and active are forced on a thumb, dragging as data-dragging on the host and thumb. Fixtures are fictional: Volume 0-100 at 0, 40 and 100, hint Applies to match highlights only., required at 95 with error Keep the volume at 80 or below.; steps of 10 with and without ticks; Quality with Low, Medium, High; Price range 20-80, 0-100, met at 50, in steps of 20 EUR; mixed with Different volumes, hint The selected clips disagree.; vertical with a value bubble and with labelled ticks; an unlabelled slider. Framed as a page with 16px padding at 320, 360 and 640. Numbers (light / dark), from shot pixels at scale 2 at 360, brand mint, a: rail (32 % surface-interaction) vs page 1.51 / 1.81; fill and thumb (primary) 1.33 / 13.50, thumb vs rail 1.14 / 7.45; focus ring (primary) 1.33 / 13.50; disabled (opacity 0.4) thumb 1.19 / 3.09, rail 1.18 / 1.22; thumb 18px, no border, so box-sizing does not change its size; the interaction box is 44px tall and the full track width on et-slider, so the touch target passes there; the thumb at min and max stays inside the host (margin-inline half a thumb) and lines up its outer edge with the label. Hover, active and dragging draw exactly like rest; readonly draws exactly like rest; invalid only turns the fill and thumb danger. Decided rules that arise: Q88 (the focus ring in ink; the invalid one takes the danger ink), Q99a (the mint fill and the mixed dashed rail take light-dark(ink, primary), the mint thumb keeps a 1px inset ink edge, the required marker light-dark(ink, primary)) and Q101 (a thumb hovers and drags to -active). No et-description on the slider, so form-field L1 does not arise. Lib bugs apart: (S1) the value bubble overlaps et-label: nothing reserves room above the interaction box (Storybook Range Slider Default with showValueLabel at 360: bubble y 33.8-56.6, label y 42-57.6, the 20 bubble cuts Price range; Slider Value Label: bubble y 41.8-64.6 over the label row); b and c draw an 18px block-start margin. (S2) et-range-slider has a 28px interaction box, et-slider 44px (Storybook: h 28.0 vs 44.0); b and c draw 44px. (S3) vertical tick labels hang outside the host on the inline-start side (Storybook Vertical Marks at 360: host x 42, Medium x 11, High x 27, Low x 29); in a 16px page Medium is clipped and sketch check fails their contrast in a; b and c draw a 32px inline-start margin. (S4, minor) the bubble and tick label on an end tick centre on it and overhang the host (Range Slider Labelled Marks: first label x 29, host x 42; range-ends: the 0 bubble 7px left of the host). Design: (1) WCAG 1.4.11: the rail 1.51 / 1.81 is the only edge of the unfilled track; c draws it in surface-interaction, 4.74 / 6.94, but in light the ink fill then sits at 1.16 against it, told apart by hue only. (2) No hover, pressed or dragging look in a; Q101 in b shifts the thumb to -active, barely visible on an 18px thumb; c adds a 6px primary halo at 28 % while pressed or dragged (my proposal). (3) Readonly looks exactly like an editable slider and keeps focus; c draws a ring thumb in the page colour with a 2px light-dark(ink, primary) border (my proposal, box-sizing set). (4) On the ink fill of b and c the active ticks (on-primary at 70 %) sit near 3.0 against it, weaker than on the mint. (5) The error marker 3.71 in dark, exempted as in checkbox r1. (6) Invalid has no mark beyond the danger colour of fill and thumb. Later rounds, left out here: thumb size tokens, the colour themes besides brand, RTL, the dragging motion and the bubble on focus only.

a.note: Today, the lib as is. On light the fill, thumb and focus ring are mint, 1.33 vs page (dark 13.50); the rail 1.51 / 1.81, under 3:1; hover, pressed, dragging and readonly draw like rest; the value bubble overlaps the label (S1), the range box is 28px (S2), vertical tick labels hang outside the host (S3).

b.note: Pick. a plus Q88, Q99a and Q101, decided rules only, plus S1-S3 drawn fixed. The fill and the mixed dashed rail in light-dark(ink, primary), light 5.48 vs page (was 1.33), 3.63 vs the rail; the mint thumb keeps a 1px inset ink edge; the focus ring in ink, light 5.48 (was 1.33), the invalid one the danger ink; the required marker light-dark(ink, primary); hover and drag shift the thumb to -active. An 18px block-start margin under the label when a value bubble shows, the range box 44px, a 32px inline-start margin for vertical tick labels. Rail, readonly and disabled unchanged. Picked because it applies only decided rules and lib bug fixes.

c.note: b plus three proposals, not decided rules: the rail in surface-interaction, 4.74 / 6.94 vs page (was 1.51 / 1.81), but the ink fill then sits 1.16 against it in light, told apart by hue only; a 6px primary halo at 28 % on a pressed or dragged thumb; a readonly thumb drawn as a ring (page fill, 2px light-dark(ink, primary) border, border-box) so readonly no longer looks draggable.
